metadata.name: GetPlanAndPaymentByAmount
metadata.description: This brings plans and payments for given Product/Merchant/Transaction Amount.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Number which is assgined to a Merchant. Valid Values- 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example: 92234 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Amount of Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:200.00

request_fields.name: ProductMapping
request_fields.description: Product Mapping Code Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Format: XXXX Example: 3399 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: PreQualID
request_fields.description: This tag refers to Pre-qualification ID of corecard Application Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Format: XXXX Example: 3399 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: ApplicationID
request_fields.description: This tag reflects the Application ID of an application. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 3399

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number will ensure that API hit our internal servers. This will always be unique.API is returned from our external server Valid Values:0-9,a-z Format: XXX Example:200 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CreditPlanMaster
children.description: Plan name associated with the card account. Valid Values: A-z,0-9 Format: XXX Example:6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full Allowable Values: 6

children.name: CreditPlanDescription
children.description: CreditPlanMaster Description Valid Values: A-z,0-9 Format: XXX Example: 6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full Allowable Values: 255

children.name: CreditPlanType
children.description: Credit Plan Type i.e. EPP for ILP and Deferred for deferred plan. Example: Deferred Allowable Values: 20

children.name: LoanTerm
children.description: Total tenure of loan in months. Example:48 Allowable Values: 2

children.name: LowRate
children.description: Low Rate of CreditPlanMaster (This will contain APR for Deferred plan if this is Deferred Plan) Valid Values:A-z,0-9 Format:XXX Example:29.9900 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: HighRate
children.description: High Rate of CreditPlanMaster (This will not have any value if it is a deferred plan) Example:29.9900 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: InterestRate
children.description: Rate of Interest (ILP only) It will show LowRate-High rate(1.00-1.75) for ILP Example: 14.99 - 28.99 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TotalInterestAmount
children.description: Total Interest Amount for ILP Example: 369.28 - 770.08 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: EMIAmount
children.description: EMI Amount (ILP only) It will show LowRateEMIAmt – HighRateEMIAmt(10.00 – 29.999) for ILP Format: XXX Example: "30.61 - 38.96" Allowable Values: 20

children.name: DefermentPeriod
children.description: Deferment Period For Interest Deferment Format: XXX Example: 12 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: OptionalPaymentToAvoidInterest
children.description: Optional Payment To Avoid Interest For Interest Deferment. Example:91.6700 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: MonthlyMinimumRequiredPayment
children.description: Required Payment For Interest Deferment. Valid Values:A-z,0- Format:XXX Example:35.7500 Allowable Values: 20
